author: Niko McCarty
title: Creative Fellowship for scientific illustrator
content: We're launching a Creative Fellowship for an artist or scientific illustrator at @AsimovPress. This is a paid, 20hr/wk, three-month program (with negotiable, but competitive, pay.) You'd help revamp our website and make all the art for our upcoming Issue, plus work on your own projects. If you are interested, please send three samples of prior work to my email, niko[at]asimov[dot]com, with a few sentences about who you are and why you are interested. We are especially looking for artists or illustrators who have an understanding of biology, yet maintain a unique style.
